title: Reply to a request
summary: Express.js: Reply to a request. Change the reply text and restart the server.
introduction: A route pairs a method and path with a function. Open GET / to receive this text.
learningObjectives: Reply to a request with Express.js
Change the reply text and restart the server

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install express@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use the stated URL on http://127.0.0.1:3000; stop with Ctrl+C before another example.

blocks.title: Reply to a request

blocks.text: The GET path matches /. Express passes request and response objects to the handler, which sends the greeting.
Change the reply text and restart the server.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The method and path must both match the route.
